All essential labels large, generous whitespace.
Title: "Classifying a repository"
Subtitle: "Prepare evidence and choices locally. Let the LLM select supported IDs."
Stop 1 heading "1. Build evidence": semantic metadata card and README, with two clear output slips "E0: metadata" and "E1+: README excerpts". Metadata small labels "Name · Description · Topics · Language".

"E0 + up to 2 excerpts"
"Up to 8 phrases"
"Candidate IDs + kinds + names + descriptions"

Bottom takeaway exactly: "RAKE supplies phrases. TF-IDF searches evidence text."

Keep the current algorithmic meaning, but make the MAIN FOUR-STOP path so clear it requires no interpretation.
